notAnIdeology.explanation: Wikipedia describes a wave of protests and occupations (17 September 2011 to 9 November 2016, with locations, methods, arrests, injuries and deaths in its infobox) against economic inequality and corporate influence over government. It is a dated protest episode, not a set of political ideas for how to run a society; the ideologies its participants held (anarchism, socialism, progressivism and others) are audited separately.
